details: This package is a dependency-confusion proof of concept. Its postinstall hook runs beacon.cjs, which POSTs a JSON body to hxxp://185[.]158[.]107[.]175:8787/_ah/dc with the header X-Beacon-Package. The body contains only install metadata: the package name, the machine hostname, the install directory (__dirname), the working directory, the npm user-agent string, and the protocol. index.js additionally fires the same beacon when the module is required, and exports a no-op Proxy so a consuming build completes instead of crashing. No credentials, environment values, tokens, wallet data or file contents are read or transmitted, and no further payload is downloaded or executed. The README describes the package as part of an authorized dependency-confusion test and credits researcher Kero (@0xWise). This package is a dependency-confusion proof of concept. Its postinstall hook runs beacon.cjs, which sends a single HTTP POST of JSON host metadata — package name, hostname, install path, working directory and Node version — to hxxp://185[.]158[.]107[.]175:8787/_ah/dc with an X-Beacon-Package header. index.js re-fires the same beacon when the module is imported and exports a no-op Proxy so importing code does not crash. No credentials, tokens, environment values or file contents are read or transmitted.
